name: MONSTER WAR
detailed_description:
MONSTER WAR is a clicker game about a religious world in which each of your clicks writes an endless story of struggle. Fight hordes of monsters, collect powerful equipment, brew potions from monster organs (not a joke) and improve yourself everywhere and anywhere. Trade, communicate, exchange promo codes and bonuses, trade freely with others — this online world lives and breathes with you. Every monster you kill, every choice you make, is your opportunity to become stronger.

There are no boundaries in this game: only you, your strength and the endless fight against monsters — for greatness, fame and wealth! Take action and the game world will react.

ENDLESS STRUGGLE

Fight against monsters that have no end: sorcerers, bandits, beasts, skeletons, centaurs, dragons, piranhas and otherworldly entities — you can't count them all!

The damage caused by your click is not just a number on the screen. This is an indicator of your superiority and becoming in the endlessly tormented world of the game MONSTER WAR.

FREEDOM FOR YOUR POWER

Do you want to squeeze resources, getting the most out of every click? Towering over your enemies at the speed of light? Deal septillions of damage with a single click? Would you like to make a fortune with builds with a bonus to the Gold you receive?

Yes, there is that too. And yes, you are free to combine all these assignments as you wish, thereby creating unique sets of equipment.

GAMEPLAY-RELATED MECHANICS

Every mechanic, every system presented in MONSTER WAR is closely related to all other mechanics. Every use of game elements made here changes the course of the game.

A NEW MILESTONE IN THE GENRE

MONSTER WAR is a game created to say a new word in the clicker games genre.

This game gives you new mechanics, systems, ideas and images that never seen before in any clicker game.
